digest.component_or_area: tests/interfaces test harness and rebar_repo fixture
propositions: tests/interfaces setup phase consumes 47% of tier wall-clock (361.4s of 1385s total) due to function-scoped rebar_repo running git init and filesystem operations per test (306ms each, 589 tests)
rebar_repo function-scoped fixture spawns 58 git processes and runs 306ms per test due to mkdir, git init, git config (2x), rebar.init_repo(), and git commit operations

Session-scoped template fixture with per-test copytree (13.7x faster: 306ms -> 22.3ms) requires fixing four sharing axes: worktree pointers (absolute paths in .git files), snapshot store keying by SHA alone, environment identity files (.env-id, .signing-key) shared across tests, and module-global _pending_cache
Bare git worktree repair is a silent no-op that leaves copies pointing to the template's object store and refs, making test writes advance the template's refs invisibly
Template fixture must build in isolated MonkeyPatch.context() with REBAR_ROOT, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, and config env vars pinned to prevent contamination from first-requester's autouse environment
Tier-wide autouse guard must verify all git worktree list --porcelain paths resolve inside REBAR_ROOT (not --git-common-dir, which is insufficient) and reject half-fixed or improperly repaired copies
